mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: PatMapper.selectPatCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_pat t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.patk_regr_id = #{patkRegrId}

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PatMapper.selectPatList */ t1.patk_id, t1.tokn_nm, t1.tokn_val, t1.tokn_exp_date, t1.patk_regr_id, t1.patk_regr_nm, t1.patk_reg_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_pat t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.patk_regr_id = #{patkRegrId} ORDER BY t1.patk_id DESC

SELECT /* SQL_ID: PatMapper.selectPat */ t1.patk_id, t1.tokn_nm, t1.tokn_val, t1.tokn_exp_date, t1.patk_regr_id, t1.patk_regr_nm, t1.patk_reg_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_pat t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.patk_id = #{patkId}
mapper.delete: DELETE /* SQL_ID: PatMapper.deletePat */ FROM dtmeta.tb_portal_pat WHERE 1=1 AND patk_id = #{patkId}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('PAT', EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now())::int, LPAD(CAST(NEXTVAL('dtmeta.seq_tb_portal_common') AS varchar), 6, '0'))
